verdict.rationale: Cline is documented as an AI coding assistant in your editor. It ships as an IDE extension for VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains, Windsurf and others, and you work with it through natural conversation, with Plan mode letting it read your codebase and discuss strategy. Community users corroborate daily IDE use. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party description of the in-IDE chat panel UI or of editor-context features such as selection or file mentions within the IDE.

support.subject: As a developer, I can chat with the coding assistant directly inside my IDE for contextual help
